name: mdx-forge-fleet-eval-harness
model_matrix_rule: models must be behind an MDx-approved Responses-compatible provider profile or proxy before Codex can use them
runner_model_casting_policy: Fleet casts are runner x model pairs filtered by admitted wire API compatibility, policy profile, quarantine boundary, and per-runner clearance status before a worker can be planned
evidence_policy: external outputs stay quarantined until MDx quality gates accept them
dry_run_policy: local dry runs emit runner execution, result ingestion, and scoring receipts for every task and model profile without provider calls
provider_preflight_policy: provider preflight reports credential presence only and never exposes or records secret values; an authorized official adapter may receive only its tenant-scoped credential
live_run_approval_policy: human approval records provider allowlist, spend cap, task cap, parallelism cap, redaction, retention, and stop conditions without granting execution authority; live execution additionally requires the exact current fleet-eval clearance receipt, the exact approval id and receipt, an unused task slot, an approved per-trial spend, an adapter-specific runtime opt-in, an explicit live request, and a present runner binary
machine_league_live_codex_policy: Codex CLI execution requires an explicit request, MDX_MACHINE_LEAGUE_CODEX_EXEC=1, exact current fleet-eval clearance, exact reviewed provider approval, and approved task and spend capacity; it runs in an isolated clone, captures JSONL diff check output and handoff notes, and remains quarantined until principal review
grok_build_adapter_policy: Grok Build runs through official ACP stdio with the exact approved model; the tenant-scoped XAI_API_KEY reaches only the scrubbed Grok child, GROK_HOME is isolated per run under quarantine, operator Grok state is excluded, adapter events are secret-redacted, and output never gains MDx authority
kimi_code_adapter_policy: Kimi Code runs non-interactively with stream-json in an isolated worktree and KIMI_CODE_HOME; the tenant-scoped MOONSHOT_API_KEY is remapped only into Kimi Code's documented ephemeral KIMI_MODEL_* channel, telemetry, cron, auto-update, and unbounded agent swarm are disabled, events are secret-redacted, and output never gains MDx authority
machine_runtime_fingerprint_policy: Machine League preflight and live trials record binary path, observed version output, checksum when readable, adapter contract version, command contract, fingerprint id, prior fingerprint id, drift status, and compatibility status before any result can be treated as scorecard evidence
machine_runtime_smoke_policy: A live external run that records runtime_drift_detected cannot be accepted into the scoreboard until the same runner and runtime fingerprint has a passed version-only runtime smoke receipt
machine_league_fleet_cast_policy: Posting to /forge/machine-league/fleet-casts.json records a governed 8/16/24-wide cast plan across compatible runner x model pairs without executing adapters, consuming external output, opening provider secret export, or allowing production writes
machine_league_fleet_run_policy: Posting to /forge/machine-league/fleet-runs.json executes or stages each lane from a cast plan through the same quarantined trial routes, records lane receipts and a fleet summary, and never consumes output, accepts scorecard evidence, distills learning, or writes production without separate governed review gates
machine_league_fleet_run_arbitration_pol: Posting to /forge/machine-league/fleet-runs/arbitrations.json recommends a fleet winner only from lane run ids with accepted scorecard evidence and stops at human ratification without consuming output or writing production
machine_league_native_improvement_loop_p: Posting to /forge/machine-league/native-improvement-loops.json schedules an accepted distillation note as a governed Builder Loop tick and records a same-fixture native remeasurement plan without applying learning directly, consuming external output, claiming lift, or writing production
machine_league_native_runtime_adaptation: GET /forge/machine-league/native-runtime-adaptations.json exposes open human-granted learning adaptations that can steer normal Forge native builder casting and prompt context, and Machine League fleet casts stamp and receipt any applied adaptation without changing model routing, budgets, checks, review depth, or production authority
machine_league_face_off_policy: Posting to /forge/machine-league/face-offs.json packages recommendation, cast plan, runner model profile, adapter tier, trial status, native comparison state, and learning status without granting production authority
closed_runner_clearance_policy: Codex CLI, Claude Code, Grok Build, and Kimi Code require operator-attested runner clearance before live fleet eval execution; local companion clearance is visible but not scorecard eligible
result_ingestion_policy: external eval results are receipt-recorded as quarantined evidence and are not accepted for the scoreboard until MDx quality gates pass
diff_language_pack_impact_policy: result ingestion requires diff_language_pack_impact to include the submitted language_pack_id so actual touched-stack evidence can be sliced without trusting external output
principal_review_gate_coverage_policy: result ingestion requires principal_review_gate_results to cover every required gate before a quarantined receipt is recorded
artifact_identity_policy: result ingestion requires quarantined artifact refs and a well-formed sha256 digest before a quarantined receipt is recorded
standards_source_fingerprint_policy: result ingestion requires allowlisted standards-source fnv1a64 fingerprints before a quarantined receipt is recorded
principal_engineer_verdict_policy: result ingestion requires pending_principal_engineer_review until MDx-owned quality gates and human review record a later verdict
forbidden_capabilities: no external adapter execution without exact clearance, approval, provider, budget, and runtime gates
no provider secret in model-visible tools, transcripts, or receipts
no external output consumption without governed distillation
no package metadata as standards evidence
